items.title: UK threatens to ban Eritreans over migrant return policy
items.summary: The home secretary said she would not hesitate to impose measures on other countries "refusing to co-operate".

items.title: School owner arrested after dozens of children killed in roof collapse
items.summary: At least 28 children and their teacher have died after a school roof collapsed in Pakistan.

items.title: Healey says surprise UK growth is 'sign of resilience' ahead of Budget
items.summary: The economy grew by 0.1% in August, defying analysts' expectations of a slight contraction.

items.title: Family of man killed by tiger raise concerns about his contact with mental health services, inquest hears
items.summary: The family of William Chapman, who died after he was attacked by a tiger, have expressed concerns about his contact with mental health services before his death, an inquest has heard.

items.title: Reform faces criticism after councillors filmed making racist comments
items.summary: Reform says all of those people filmed by ITV are under investigation having resigned or been suspended.

items.title: New White House press secretary already under pressure over her claims to be a lawyer
items.summary: Katie Zacharia faces mounting scrutiny over her legal credentials, with an advocacy group asking whether the self-described lawyer has the qualifications to support her claims.
